intro: At Sentinel Hill, Quartermaster Lewis sends an urgent supply requisition to a private armorer in Stormwind. A courier carries it by gryphon, asking for protective gear for the Westfall garrison.

p: The People's Militia at Sentinel Hill gets little support from Stormwind's House of Nobles. Skirmishes with the Defias Brotherhood keep draining its meager stocks of gear. To keep the defenders outfitted, Quartermaster Lewis turns to private business instead of crown supplies. His requisition bypasses official military channels entirely. An Alliance courier must fly by gryphon to Old Town and present the order to Osric Strang, proprietor of Limited Immunity.
